responsibility: Implements RTL loop-invariant code motion. It scans loop instructions to detect simple invariant computations, builds dependence information between invariant-producing insns, estimates profitability and register-pressure impact, and hoists selected insns out of loops while creating temporaries or propagating values when needed. The pass works loop-by-loop on RTL and is intentionally limited to relatively simple non-memory invariants, complementing earlier GIMPLE-level motion rather than replacing it.
